James A.Ridgway,son of the late James B.Ridgway
and Lillian M.Ridgway,was born December 17,1914 in
Dover, Delaware. He departed this life on Wednesday
September 21,1977 at Chestnut Hill Hospital,Chestnut
Hill, Pa. after a lengthy illness
He attended the Palmyra Public School System and
vas a graduate of the Class of 1934.As a youngster he
attended Mt.Zion A.M.E.Church School.Riverton,N.J
He moved to Philadelphia in1951.He was united in
marriage to Naomi Robinson on August 22,1959.Naomi
nas been a loyal and devoted wife especially during her
rying times these past sevenyears
Austin"as he was known to most Palmyrians retired
last year on disability after twenty-five years of service
with the State ofPennsylyaniaHe andhis wife had
made plans to move to Connecticut in the near future.He
was really looking forward to it.We loved him but God
lovedhim best.He leaves to mourn his loving wife
Naomi,two sisters-Mrs.Lee Green ofPhiladelphia,Mrs
Phyllis Scottof Palmyra,4 nieces,1nephew3 great
